data.title: 火打谷爱衣 · 更衣室百叶窗下的心跳
data.description: 运动结束后的空旷更衣室内，夕阳透过百叶窗在爱衣微湿的运动背心上投下光栅。两人被困在狭小的储物柜前，近到能感受到彼此胸口的起伏。向来元气直爽的爱衣此刻完全慌了神，双颊红透，双手攥紧毛巾低头不敢对视。
data.action: standing against locker, holding towel, sweating gently, intense blush
data.lighting: sunset slatted blind shadows across room
data.promptProse: Cornered against the metal lockers as sunset streams through slatted blinds, Hiuchidani Mei stands in her sporty athletic tank top with a light sheen of sweat. Her cheeks glow bright red as her breath hitches in breathless close proximity.
data.animaCaption: Mei flustered with a heavy blush in the sunlit locker room.
